steps.text: This page tracks the dossiers filed with the CWaPE and the grid operator. Every dossier concerns exactly one sharing operation: a community running several operations files one dossier per operation.
steps.title: No dossier yet

steps.text: Click "New dossier" to open the creation form.
steps.title: Create a dossier

steps.text: The type decides which regulatory deadlines are derived later. Here, a community creation notification.
steps.title: Choose the dossier type

steps.text: Pick the sharing operation the filing is about. It supplies the members and meters that the dossier's documents will list.
steps.title: Choose the sharing operation

steps.text: Give the dossier a title that sets it apart from the others.
steps.title: Name the dossier

steps.text: The title is free text — it is how you will recognise the dossier. The reference is the one assigned by the authority; it identifies the dossier uniquely and stays editable later.
steps.title: Title and reference

steps.text: Submit: the dossier is created and joins the tracking table.
steps.title: Create

steps.text: The dossier shows up in the table with the status "In preparation". Until it is submitted it stays editable and no deadline is running.
steps.title: The dossier is created

steps.text: Click anywhere on the row to open the dossier page.
steps.title: Open the dossier

steps.text: The dossier page gathers everything about the filing: its documents, its deadlines and the history of its status changes. The buttons at the top offer only the status changes that are legal right now.
steps.title: The dossier page
